about.en: Milady Cult Coin is the token of CULT, INC., the project of Remilia Corporation, creator of the Milady Maker NFT collection. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x0000000000c5dc95539589fbd24be07c6c14eca4 with 18 decimals and the on-chain symbol CULT; some exchanges list it as MILADYCULT. It is unrelated to Cult DAO's CULT token.
